title: FAIRT2V: Training-Free Debiasing for Text-to-Video Diffusion Models

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying implicit gender associations in text encoders using a gender-leaning score (projecting neutral prompt embeddings onto a constructed gender axis), and evaluating video generation fairness using a Video Fair Ratio (VFR) that measures the Jensen-Shannon divergence of VideoLLM-classified and human-annotated gender distributions for neutral occupational prompts against a uniform target distribution.
